title: ML & MLOps Projects
description: Four projects cover machine learning and machine learning operations (MLOps). Three build a bike-sharing demand pipeline, from Dagster preprocessing and XGBoost training to MLflow tracking, data versioning, a FastAPI endpoint, and automated retraining.

title: WebBoost
description: WebBoost analyzes a blog post URL and returns a weighted score with prioritized recommendations. It checks readability, navigation, and SEO signals such as metadata, indexing, and internal links.

title: MediaSleuth360
description: MediaSleuth360 is a Python and Streamlit app that transcribes and summarizes uploaded audio or video. Ask a question about the content to find the relevant timestamps.

title: Checkers AI
description: A Python and Pygame implementation of American Checkers with two AI opponents. One uses Minimax with alpha-beta pruning. The other uses Q-learning and can be trained against Minimax.

title: Raycasting in Maze
description: A C++ and SDL2 maze explorer that converts a randomly generated 2D maze into a first-person 3D view using raycasting.

title: Fylio
description: Fylio replaces local file directory listings in Chromium browsers with a Finder-style interface. It adds grid and list views, breadcrumb navigation, search, and sorting.
